query: 平等机会措施 平等机会措施 衡量企业在招聘、晋升及培训选拔过程中，为确保所有员工/候选人获得平等机会而设立的流程标准及量化监控机制。 一、内容质量得分 • 2分（卓越）：具备标准化的公平评估流程（如：结构化面试、匿名简历筛选、多元化评审委员会）；设定了具体的公平性监控指标（如：女性在关键岗位晋升中的提名率）；且定期审计流程中的潜在偏差。 • 1分（合格）：有明确的公平准则说明，具备基础的公开招聘/竞聘流程及员工培训选拔标准，但缺乏深层的偏差纠正工具或量化的公平监控指标。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关公平措施披露，或仅有笼统的“机会均等”声明。 平等机会 公平招聘 结构化面试 匿名简历 多元评审委员会 晋升提名率 薪酬平等 流程偏差审计 公开竞聘 equal opportunity fair recruitment structured interview blind CV screening diverse interview panel promotion nomination rate pay equity process bias audit open competition 招聘、晋升或培训选拔是否有明确公平准则、公开招聘/竞聘流程或统一选拔标准？ 是否采用结构化面试、匿名简历筛选或多元评审委员会？ 是否设定女性关键岗位提名率、晋升率或薪酬平等等监控指标？ 是否定期审计并纠正选拔流程中的潜在偏差？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '平等机会措施'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 招聘、晋升或培训选拔是否有明确公平准则、公开招聘/竞聘流程或统一选拔标准？ 是否采用结构化面试、匿名简历筛选或多元评审委员会？ 是否设定女性关键岗位提名率、晋升率或薪酬平等等监控指标？ 是否定期审计并纠正选拔流程中的潜在偏差？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有反歧视原则声明而无流程工具；仅有灵活办公；仅有员工满意度调查；仅有多元化人数占比而无选拔公平机制；区分：平等机会措施强调选拔流程与量化公平监控；反歧视政策强调禁止歧视规则；培训百分比是结果统计，不能单独证明存在公平选拔机制。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: During the Reporting Period, Ju Teng International strictly complied with the 'Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China' to protect the fair competition market and stop unfair competition practices. We have established this Code as a programmatic document to achieve the Company's professional ethics, honest operation and compliance goals. In accordance with this Code, we have formulated the internal 'Business Ethics Management Procedure' to strictly manage the business ethics of our employees. results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International clarifies the cooperation, communication, and management model with suppliers and potential suppliers at all stages through the 'Supplier Management Procedure'. Through effective management of suppliers, Ju Teng International understands suppliers' quality, price, delivery, coordination, labour, environmental protection, safety, ethics and other relevant information, and follows up and deals with supplier problems in a timely manner. For different types of suppliers, Ju Teng International has different management processes in order to manage them in a more targeted manner. For example, for the management of non-enclosure suppliers, Ju Teng International revised the relevant management requirements (on-site audit, production part approval process (PPAP) submission, quality technical agreement terms, etc.). After an abnormal problem occurs, the 8D or applicable problem solving procedures are initiated so that the abnormal problem can be solved in a timely and thorough manner.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION / Energy management
results.text: Purchased electricity, natural gas and diesel are the main types of energy consumed by Ju Teng International in the course of production and operation. Ju Teng International has systematically strengthened the management of energy use through the 'Energy and Resource Management Procedure'. By adopting environmentally and socially friendly measures which are technically feasible and economically viable, we have actively updated our internal management regulations on energy use and mobilised all employees to save energy and reduce consumption. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant has adopted scientific methods to formulate production quota assessment and fully motivate the staff to save energy and reduce consumption through the combination of assessment and reward and punishment system. According to the load change and operation condition of the equipment, the characteristics of frequency conversion control technology are used to carry out energy-saving technical transformation of some equipment running at low load, which has achieved a power saving rate of about 30%. Meanwhile, all plants adopt green lighting to reduce energy consumption.

In addition to the basic health and safety regulations and systems, Ju Teng International has also formulated the 'Risk Assessment and Control Management Procedures', 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Procedures' and 'Production Safety Accident Emergency Management System' according to its own industry characteristics. In addition, the Group's various safety systems enable the Group identify the risk sources in the process of production, services and activities, control the risks in all links, and take measures to influence the possible hazards, so that the risks can be controlled effectively to achieve the policy of 'Safety First, Prevention First, and Comprehensive Management'.
